def inside(path: str) -> bool:
    """True when path is relative and, with "." and ".." segments resolved
    lexically, never climbs above its starting directory and names at least
    one entry. Absolute paths, empty paths, and paths containing a NUL or a
    backslash are not inside."""
    ex inside("a.txt") == True
    ex inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
    ex inside("sub/b.txt") == True
    ex inside("..") == False
    ex inside("sub/../../x") == False
    ex inside("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex inside("") == False
    ex inside(".") == False
    if path.startswith("/"):
        return False
    if "\\" in path or "\0" in path:
        return False
    depth = 0
    for seg in path.split("/"):
        if seg == "" or seg == ".":
            continue
        if seg == "..":
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
        else:
            depth += 1
    return depth > 0

def read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file at path inside the directory notes, or "" when the
    path is not inside notes, or the file is missing or unreadable. Reads only
    through fs confined to notes with fs.sub("notes"). Examples: "..",
    "/etc/passwd" and "sub/../../x" give ""; a missing file gives ""."""
    post inside(path) or out == ""
    if not inside(path):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read(path) else ""
    return text
